description: Contextual high-density residential district. Quality Housing mandatory. Produces 6-story brownstone-scale buildings with lower height than R8A. Brownstone row house character.

bulk.far_note: UAP standard. Lower FAR than R8A but higher than R7A. Community facility FAR per ZR §24-11.

height_setback.street_wall_setback_wide_st: 10 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_setback_narrow_st: 15 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_location: No closer than buildings within 150 ft on same block
height_setback.notes: Per ZR §23-432 table (R8B row). Six-story buildings typical. Max building height 75 ft standard; 95 ft qualifying. R8B excluded from certain §23-44 alternative location allowances.

side.requirement: Per §23-335: none required for Quality Housing contextual

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft

dob_filing_notes: R8B produces lower buildings than R8A — confirm district vs R8A
Six-story brownstone character — verify neighborhood context
